title: Canonical-model ordinary exceptional comparison
statement: For a family R, there exists a family of ForgetModels model such that for every X,Y,f₀,S,c under the stated separated, locally finite type and quasi-compact hypotheses, there is a natural isomorphism nativeShriek D l f₀ ⋙ (model Y).functor ≅ (model X).functor ⋙ (S.ring.operation c .closed).F.

proof.text: For each T, transport native forgetting along closureMap T. This pushforward is inverse exact pullback, so it preserves bounded constructibility. Full faithfulness and the image clause of the specified R.data.realization lift that functor to the common-stage category. Whisker the lift comparison with sectionDerived to obtain the required ForgetModel realization; this constructs a single family model before choosing f₀,S,c.

proof.text: For the chosen native compactification of f₀.left, restrict NativeWeilOpenProper.compactificationComparison along the WeilComplex inclusion. Compose with the ordinary closure transport comparison, whiskered with forgetting into the bounded constructible category. Then compose with the inverse specified coefficient-system scalar-realization comparison. This gives the desired comparison after postcomposition with the native realization J_Y.

theorem native_exceptional_ordinary_counit_model_comparison (R : Family l D) :
    ∃ model : ∀ T : Space D, ForgetModel D l R T,
      ∀ (X Y : Space D) (f₀ : X.base ⟶ Y.base)
        [IsSeparated f₀.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀.left] [QuasiCompact f₀.left]
        (S : CoefficientSystem D l f₀)
        (c : Compactification (geometricMap D f₀)),
      Nonempty (nativeShriek D l f₀ ⋙ (model Y).functor ≅
        (model X).functor ⋙ (S.ring.operation c .closed).F)
